descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
The dream drive, from the driver's seat - in Basel.

THE CAR
A V12 sports car with a race cockpit: racing wheel, bucket seats, roll cage, shift lights and a live display. Grip the wheel, work the gear stick and pull the handbrake with your own hands - or drive with the joysticks.

A REAL 6-SPEED MANUAL
Move the stick through a real H-pattern, rev it to the shift lights and snap the next gear in. Prefer to cruise? Switch to automatic.

45 KM OF BASEL
The A2 and A3 from Muttenz past Pratteln and Augst to Rheinfelden. Through the old town, then Route 3 west with the Rhine on your right, past the Roman theatre of Augusta Raurica. North over the Rhine on the Schwarzwaldbrücke, through Kleinbasel under the Roche Towers, back on the Dreirosenbrücke and round the Spalenring to St. Jakob-Park.

ROAD EVENTS
Seven events on real roads, from the Rhine Road to The Full Loop. The lights count you down, you race for gold - and your best run comes back as a ghost car to beat.

SPEED TRAPS AND RUSH HOUR
Six speed cameras record your top speed. In Rush Hour, close passes build your combo, a crash loses it.

SUNSET, DAY AND NIGHT
Golden light along the Rhine at sunset, bright Swiss sun with cargo barges on the river, or the Münster and the Roche Towers lit up after dark.

ENGLISH AND GERMAN
The game follows your headset's language.

Plus an original soundtrack on the car radio, a garage of paints, twenty achievements, career ranks and a map with quick travel.
